issue.title: dual boundary class can have a bad pair

summary.text: The bug was reproduced, but two tests that passed before the fix now fail after it (test_boundary_dual.py::TestDualBoundaryMethodsGeneral::test_custom_ind_selection and test_vort.py::TestVortLogWarnings::test_vort_unexpected_line), and no test was shown to guard the reported failure. Start by examining why those two tests now fail, and decide whether the fix changed custom index selection or vort…
